swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): World population is expected to start falling after the mid-2080s. Reason (R): Birth rates are falling, so fewer people are being added even though the total is still very large. Choose the correct option.

add.q: Assertion (A): World population is expected to start falling after the mid-2080s. Reason (R): The United Nations projects that world population will peak at 8.2 billion before it starts to fall. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is true, R is false
o: A is true, R is false
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is false, R is true

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): When the fertility rate in a country falls, its birth rate falls too. Reason (R): The birth rate counts live births per 1,000 population, and fewer children per woman means fewer births to count. Choose the correct option.

add.q: Assertion (A): The death rate is defined in the chapter as the average number of children a woman would have in her lifetime. Reason (R): China's fertility rate dropped from 7.5 in 1963 to 1 in 2025. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is false, R is true
o: A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A

add.q: Assertion (A): China's fertility rate has stayed below replacement level even after the One-Child Policy ended in 2015. Reason (R): India's life expectancy at birth has risen from just 30 years at independence to 70 years in 2024. Choose the correct option.

A is false, R is true
